title: Rollers header
description: A sticky header made of solid cells: a charcoal logo cell with an orange mark and a bold wordmark, an orange cell with a spaced uppercase tagline running to the middle of the page, a white cell with the phone number and an orange Menu cell. On wide screens the wordmark tucks away during the first 120px of scroll; on phones the phone and tagline are two thin bars above it that scroll away. Menu slides a charcoal link panel in from the right.
notes: sticky, in the page flow: the next section starts below its 64px bar (phones: below the two 32px bars too)
the wordmark tuck is a CSS scroll timeline on the page scroll; browsers without it keep the wordmark
the menu panel uses the theme's dark palette
